producer_report.summary: I wrote docs/design/async-drain.md, added a proposed D145 to docs/decisions.md and added an Unreleased entry to CHANGELOG.md. The design starts from a premises table that says the build cache is off (D84). Every number is computed without a cache, and the cache-dependent figures are marked estimate or conditional. It computes about 25 minutes per landed job with one check slot, down from about 73. That figure counts failed jobs through 61 attempts for 35 landings. It also gives a per-job disk budget and a table of failure cases. It includes a [drain.pipeline] block and ten build jobs: job 1 measures the 0-hit cause and cache hits across worktrees, and job 10 raises max_in_flight. I ran only `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`, which passed. I also grepped the new file for each banned word and found none. fmt, clippy and the full test run are left to Athena.

checks_run.note: The new design file is untracked, so I also grepped it for each banned word; no match.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/async-drain.md has a section for each of the five points: read-ahead and hard-job planning; early producer start in own worktree bounded by disk; one ordered landing queue with rebase-or-return-to-producer; CI waits and self-rebuild as background awaits; ordering of records commits with several jobs in flight.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the file I wrote. Sections 4 to 8 cover the five points in that order.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep of docs/design/async-drain.md for sccache finds no statement treating it as active; each mention says D84 removed it or labels it a proposed option, and a 'Premises checked' section lists each dependency (build cache, drain, producer, verifier, disk guard, config limits) with a repo path or decision id.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 1 'Premises checked' is a table with build cache, drain, producer, verifier, disk guard and config limits rows, each with paths or decision ids. The build cache row says the cache is off per D84. Section 9 (alternative e) and section 12 (job 1) call re-enabling a proposed option.

criteria_check.criterion: The design states the measured baseline (median 42 minutes; producer 15, checks 13 to 15, landing 6 to 8, verifier 2.3, reading and planning up to 5; 35 of 61 landed over 2026-10-27 to 29) and a target in minutes per landed job with stage-by-stage arithmetic that includes failed jobs' use of the check slot; unmeasured or cache-dependent figures are labeled estimate or conditional.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 2 gives the baseline table and 35 of 61. Section 3 computes 1.74 attempts per landing, 24.4 min of check slot per landing, 7 min of landing, and a target of about 25 min per landed job (estimate). The stretch of 12 to 13 min is marked conditional.

criteria_check.criterion: The disk budget per in-flight job is computed without a shared cache, with the implied in-flight limit; the [drain.pipeline] config block includes max_in_flight, max_check_slots, read_ahead and reserve_disk_gb; the text names job 10 as the one that raises max_in_flight.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 5 gives T+S of about 6.2 GB (estimate), the in-flight formula and a worked limit of 7 on an assumed 60 GB. Section 11 has the config block with all four keys. Sections 11 and 12 name job 10 as the one that raises max_in_flight.

criteria_check.criterion: Failure and conflict handling covers rebase conflict returning to the producer, failed CI, failed self-rebuild, crash mid-flight and thrash stop; alternatives are listed; ordered build jobs each sized for one producer run state dependencies, with an early job measuring cache hits across worktrees.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 6, 7 and 10 cover the five cases. Section 9 lists alternatives a to f. Section 12 has ten jobs, each with a 'Depends on' line; job 1 measures cache hits across worktrees.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has D145 with heading marked (proposed), in the existing format, linking docs/design/async-drain.md; CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry naming the design doc and the proposed decision.

open_issues: The sizes (T about 6 GB, S about 0.2 GB), the 60 GB free-disk example and the two-slot check slowdown are estimates; build jobs 1 and 9 replace them.
Job 10 edits athena.toml, a governance file, so it needs Sri's approval; the design says so.
mistakes: The first draft's header pointed to section 11 for the build jobs, which are in section 12. I fixed it before reporting.
learnings: The D84 text says D79's optional [tools.sccache] support stays in code but athena.toml no longer names sccache.
athena.toml [parallel] max_concurrency is 1 and the schema allows 1 to 8.
The policy scan reads tracked files only, so a new file needs a manual grep for the banned words.
desires: Measured size of a cold target directory and the free disk of the machine, so the disk budget would not rest on estimates.
